newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ALPINE SKIING-CRANS MONTANA SLALOM WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-CRANS MONTANA SLALOM WINNER.

text.p: Profile of Claudia Riegler, who won the World Cup women's slalom at Crans Montana on Saturday:
Total victories: 3. Slaloms -- Serre Chevalier (96), Park City (96), Crans Montana (96)

Other facts: Riegler's father is Austrian and her mother is from New Zealand, allowing her dual citizenship. A former member of the Austrian junior ski team, she left the programme after a disagreement oover training. Following first win in Serre Chevalier the Austria federation asked if she would be interested in returning to team.
